law_name: Law No. 519-V on Information about Private Life and Its Protection (Law on Personal Data)
scope: Individuals in Turkmenistan (information about private life)
applies_to: All persons and entities collecting and processing personal data (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Consent-based collection and processing with exceptions (law enforcement, statistics, journalism); 33 articles in six chapters; individuals may sue directly in court
data_categories: Personal data / information about private life (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Prosecutor General's Office of Turkmenistan (no dedicated data protection authority)
penalties_range: Administrative Code: fine of 5-10 basic units (about USD 150-294) or administrative arrest up to 15 days for handling private-life information without consent (unconfirmed)
exemptions: Law enforcement, statistics, lawful professional journalism or mass media activity
notes: Published 2017-03-29 in Neytralniy Turkmenistan; DLA Piper page last reviewed 2022
